defuss-shadcn / Multimedia / knob

Built with: CSS JS

KnobsMOL

The rotary controls of an audio plugin - a synthesizer's cutoff, a compressor's attack, a mixer's gain - over a native range input that keeps the value, the keys and the accessible slider. A knob turns 270 degrees on any scale: linear, exponential (every decade of a frequency turns as far), logarithmic, a power curve, decibels on an audio taper, or a scale the page adds; the value snaps to the input's step - stepped knobs mark their steps - and its text follows a format - a metric prefix, a percentage, milliseconds and seconds, a sign, or your own. Around the value ring - the innermost, filled from the knob's origin to its value - each automation or modulation source has a ring of its own: its range, and while it runs, how far it moves the value now; the value ring then marks the effective value. Drag left or right to turn it: near the knob it turns fast, and the farther the pointer is from it, the finer the same move sets the value - the radius it turns at full speed shows while you drag. Double click the value to type it in. The knob never moves: a longer value text spills out on both sides.

Native basis

<input type="range" class="knob-input"> in a <div class="knob">: the value in the knob's units (min, max, step, value, name), submitted and reset by its form, named by its <label for>, read as a slider. The runtime draws the dial over it; without scripting it is the plain range.

Classes

.knob.knob-input.knob-label.knob-value.knob-rings

Data attributes

• data-scale - linear, exponential, logarithmic, power, decibel or a registered one; data-exponent - the curve of power and decibel

• data-format - number, si, percent, time, signed or a registered one; data-unit, data-decimals

• data-origin - where the value arc starts (0 for pan); data-default - the value a reset goes back to

• data-ticks - a mark per step of a stepped knob; data-ticks="5" - that many over the turn

• data-radius - the precision radius in px; data-travel - the drag in px for the whole turn at full speed

• data-size - sm, lg; data-variant="flat"; data-color - chart-1 ... chart-5, destructive; --knob-reserve - ring slots kept free, so a row lines up

In script.knob-rings: an array of rings - id, label, amount (-1 to 1 of the turn), bipolar, color; df$.shadcn.knob.modulate(knob, { id: output }) runs them

Pointer and keys

• Drag left / right - turn it; the farther from the knob, the finer; Shift - ten times finer; Escape - back to where the drag started

• Double click, Ctrl / Cmd + click, Delete - the default

• Double click the value, Enter - type it in (a Number Input, xs): Enter sets it, Escape keeps the old one

• Right / Up, Left / Down - a step (the input's, else 1 % of the turn; Shift: 0.1 %); Page Up / Page Down - 10 %; Home / End - the ends

§Knob

A filter cutoff from 20 Hz to 20 kHz on an exponential scale: every decade turns as far, so 200 Hz, 2 kHz and 20 kHz sit at a third, two thirds and the end of the turn. Drag left or right to turn it - near the knob it follows the pointer fast; move away from it (the dashed circle is the radius it turns at full speed) and the same move turns it finer. Double click the knob to reset it to 1 kHz, double click the value to type one in (Enter sets it, Escape keeps the old one). Its two rings are the sources that modulate it: LFO 1 swings it both ways by 15 % of the turn, Envelope 2 opens it by 30 %.

×%

§Precision

A fine tune in cents from its centre (data-origin='0'), with a small precision radius (data-radius='48') and a long travel (data-travel='400'): within 48 px of the knob a 400 px move turns it from end to end; at 96 px half as far, at 192 px a quarter - set it to a tenth of a cent by moving away first. Shift slows any drag ten times; Escape puts it back where the drag started.

×%

§Scales

Six scales over the same turn: a mix from 0 to 1 written as a percentage (linear), a frequency (exponential, written with a metric prefix), a feedback that turns fast first and fine at the end (logarithmic), an attack time on a power curve (data-exponent='3': fine for short times, written in ms and s), a gain in decibels on an audio taper, and semitones on whole steps (step='1') that fill from 0. The value always snaps to the input's step after the scale.

×%

§Steps

Stepped knobs move step by step - a drag snaps as it goes, an arrow key moves one step, a typed value settles on the nearest. data-ticks marks every step between the value ring and the face: octaves and semitones from their centre, voices, a waveform switch (its four steps written as names by a format the page adds). data-ticks='5' marks the quarters of a mix in 5 % steps; on an exponential delay from 1 ms to 1 s in milliseconds, data-ticks='4' marks the decades.

×%

§Automation rings

Three sources around one cutoff: LFO 1 swings it both ways (bipolar), Envelope 1 opens it, Macro 1 closes it (a negative amount). Each ring shows its range around the value; run the sources and each ring shows how far its source moves the value now, while the value ring marks the effective value - the knob's value moved by all of them (df$.shadcn.knob.modulate returns it). Turn the knob while they run: the rings move with it.

×%

§Sizes, colours and states

data-size='sm' and 'lg' around the default size, data-color for the value arc (a chart colour, destructive), data-variant='flat' without the face, and an input authored disabled - the knob starts in its disabled state: no drag, no keys, and a form leaves it out.

×%

§Custom scales and formats

A page adds scales and formats by name. The crossfade turns on a smoothstep curve (data-scale='smooth'): fine at both ends, fast through the middle. The pan writes L20, C and R20 (data-format='pan'). Knobs already on a scale or a format draw again when it is added.

×%

§A synth panel

An oscillator in a Card: octave, semitones and voices on whole steps, a fine tune and a pan that fill from their centre, a level in decibels. LFO 2 modulates the detune and the pan - one source, a ring on each knob it reaches - and Envelope 1 the level: run them and the rings move together. The row keeps a ring slot free on every knob (--knob-reserve: 1), so the knobs with a ring and without one line up.

×%

§In a form

The input is the form control: it submits its value under its name, in the knob's units, and a reset puts the authored value back. The gain snaps to half decibels (step='0.5'), the mix to hundredths.

×%

§States

Named states via the shared State API, bound on each .knob:

  • default - at rest: the pointer and the arc from the origin show the value, the readout writes it
  • adjusting - being turned: a drag enters it and returns to default when it ends; the precision radius and the circle through the pointer show around the dial
  • disabled - the input is disabled: no drag, no keys, and a form leaves it out

Every state takes { value }, merged into the current config - the value in the knob's units, settled on its range and step; getState() reports the live value, also one a drag or a key set. A drag sends the input's input events and knob-change as it goes and change once when it ends.

The first example carries data-state-demo; bun run screenshots drives it via el.api.setState(name) and captures screenshots/{mode}/knob-{state}.png.

Machine contract - verified against knob.schema.json by bun run verify:

§CSS view file

The dial: every arc a conic-gradient masked down to a ring, painted from the positions the runtime writes (the value, the origin, each ring's range and live value, the effective value); the face, the pointer, the precision circles, sizes and colours.

/* -- Knob component ---------------------------------------------- */
/* A rotary control over a native range input: the dial (drawn by the */
/* runtime) turns 270 degrees from 7:30 to 4:30. Every arc is a       */
/* conic-gradient masked down to a ring - the value ring innermost,   */
/* a ring per modulation source around it - and the positions come in */
/* as custom properties (0 to 1) the runtime writes on the dial.      */
@layer components {
  .knob {
    --knob-size: 3rem;
    --knob-thickness: 0.25rem;
    --knob-ring-thickness: 0.1875rem;
    --knob-ring-gap: 0.125rem;
    --knob-color: var(--primary);
    --knob-track-color: var(--muted);
    /* the room between the value ring and the face - the marks of the steps sit in it */
    --knob-face-gap: calc(var(--knob-size) * 0.07);
    position: relative;
    display: inline-grid;
    justify-items: center;
    align-content: start;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    inline-size: max-content;
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    line-height: 1.2;
    text-align: center;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    user-select: none;
    &[data-size="sm"] {
      --knob-size: 2.25rem;
      --knob-thickness: 0.1875rem;
      --knob-ring-thickness: 0.125rem;
      --knob-ring-gap: 0.09375rem;
      font-size: 0.6875rem;
    }
    &[data-size="lg"] {
      --knob-size: 4.5rem;
      --knob-thickness: 0.3125rem;
      --knob-ring-thickness: 0.25rem;
      --knob-ring-gap: 0.125rem;
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
    }
    &[data-color="chart-1"] {
      --knob-color: var(--chart-1);
    }
    &[data-color="chart-2"] {
      --knob-color: var(--chart-2);
    }
    &[data-color="chart-3"] {
      --knob-color: var(--chart-3);
    }
    &[data-color="chart-4"] {
      --knob-color: var(--chart-4);
    }
    &[data-color="chart-5"] {
      --knob-color: var(--chart-5);
    }
    &[data-color="destructive"] {
      --knob-color: var(--destructive);
    }
    /* the one being turned: above its neighbours, so its precision circles are not cut */
    &[data-state-name="adjusting"] {
      z-index: 2;
    }
    &:has(.knob-input:disabled) {
      opacity: 0.5;
      .knob-dial {
        cursor: not-allowed;
      }
    }
    &[data-ticks] {
      --knob-face-gap: calc(var(--knob-size) * 0.15);
    }
  }
  /* the input is the form control, the keyboard target and the slider assistive technology reads - drawn over by
     the dial once the runtime runs; without scripting it is the plain range */
  @media (scripting: enabled) {
    .knob-input {
      position: absolute;
      inline-size: 1px;
      block-size: 1px;
      margin: -1px;
      padding: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 0;
      white-space: nowrap;
      clip-path: inset(50%);
    }
  }
  .knob-label {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-weight: 500;
    text-wrap: balance;
  }
  /* the value never sizes the knob: contained, a longer text ("-60.0 dB" after "0.0 dB") spills out on both sides
     and the dial stays where it is; a double click types the value in */
  .knob-value {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    justify-self: stretch;
    contain: inline-size;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    white-space: nowrap;
    cursor: text;
  }
  .knob:not(:has(.knob-input:disabled)) .knob-value:hover {
    text-decoration: underline dotted;
    text-underline-offset: 3px;
  }
  /* the editor: a Number Input (xs) laid over the readout - the knob keeps its size while it is open */
  .knob-editor {
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%;
    z-index: 3;
    inline-size: 6.5rem;
    translate: -50% -50%;
  }
  /* the dial: the knob's face, the value ring and the rings of the sources around it; geometry is physical - a knob
     turns clockwise in any writing direction */
  .knob-dial {
    --knob-step: calc(var(--knob-ring-thickness) + var(--knob-ring-gap));
    /* the ring slots: its rings, or as many as --knob-reserve keeps free - knobs in a row line up */
    --knob-slots: max(var(--knob-rings, 0), var(--knob-reserve, 0));
    --knob-dial-size: calc(var(--knob-size) + var(--knob-slots) * 2 * var(--knob-step));
    --knob-radius: var(--knob-dial-size);
    position: relative;
    display: block;
    inline-size: var(--knob-dial-size);
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    border-radius: 50%;
    direction: ltr;
    cursor: ew-resize;
    touch-action: none;
    /* the precision of a drag: the radius (dashed) within which it turns at full speed, and the circle through the
       pointer - the farther out, the finer */
    &::before,
    &::after {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      left: 50%;
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      border-radius: 50%;
      content: "";
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      translate: -50% -50%;
      transition: opacity 120ms ease;
    }
    &::before {
      inline-size: calc(var(--knob-reach, 0px) * 2);
      border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--knob-color) 45%, transparent);
    }
    &::after {
      inline-size: calc(var(--knob-radius) * 2);
      border: 1px dashed color-mix(in oklab, var(--knob-color) 70%, transparent);
    }
  }
  .knob[data-state-name="adjusting"] .knob-dial {
    &::before,
    &::after {
      opacity: 1;
    }
  }
  .knob:has(.knob-input:focus-visible) .knob-dial {
    outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
  /* the value ring: the track, the arc from the origin to the value, and - while sources move it - a mark at the
     effective value */
  .knob-track,
  .knob-ring {
    position: absolute;
    border-radius: 50%;
    -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(
      farthest-side,
      transparent calc(100% - var(--knob-w) - 0.5px),
      #000 calc(100% - var(--knob-w))
    );
    mask: radial-gradient(
      farthest-side,
      transparent calc(100% - var(--knob-w) - 0.5px),
      #000 calc(100% - var(--knob-w))
    );
  }
  .knob-track {
    --knob-w: var(--knob-thickness);
    inset: calc(var(--knob-slots) * var(--knob-step));
    background:
      conic-gradient(
        from -135deg,
        transparent 0 calc(min(var(--knob-p, 0), var(--knob-o, 0)) * 270deg),
        var(--knob-color) 0 calc(max(var(--knob-p, 0), var(--knob-o, 0)) * 270deg),
        transparent 0
      ),
      conic-gradient(from -135deg, var(--knob-track-color) 0 270deg, transparent 0);
    &::after {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      display: none;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: conic-gradient(
        from -135deg,
        transparent 0 calc(var(--knob-e, 0) * 270deg - 3deg),
        var(--foreground) 0 calc(var(--knob-e, 0) * 270deg + 3deg),
        transparent 0
      );
      content: "";
    }
  }
  .knob-dial[data-modulated] .knob-track::after {
    display: block;
  }
  /* a source's ring: its range around the value, and - while it runs - the arc to where it moves the value now */
  .knob-ring {
    /* the runtime writes each ring's own colour */
    --knob-ring-color: var(--chart-1);
    --knob-w: var(--knob-ring-thickness);
    inset: calc((var(--knob-slots) - var(--knob-ring, 1)) * var(--knob-step));
    background:
      conic-gradient(
        from -135deg,
        transparent 0 calc(var(--knob-from, 0) * 270deg),
        color-mix(in oklab, var(--knob-ring-color) 80%, transparent) 0 calc(var(--knob-to, 0) * 270deg),
        transparent 0
      ),
      conic-gradient(from -135deg, color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted) 70%, transparent) 0 270deg, transparent 0);
    &[data-live] {
      background:
        conic-gradient(
          from -135deg,
          transparent 0 calc(var(--knob-at-lo, 0) * 270deg),
          var(--knob-ring-color) 0 calc(var(--knob-at-hi, 0) * 270deg),
          transparent 0
        ),
        conic-gradient(
          from -135deg,
          transparent 0 calc(var(--knob-from, 0) * 270deg),
          color-mix(in oklab, var(--knob-ring-color) 35%, transparent) 0 calc(var(--knob-to, 0) * 270deg),
          transparent 0
        ),
        conic-gradient(from -135deg, color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted) 70%, transparent) 0 270deg, transparent 0);
    }
  }
  /* the knob's face and its pointer, turned to the value */
  .knob-face {
    position: absolute;
    inset: calc(var(--knob-slots) * var(--knob-step) + var(--knob-thickness) + var(--knob-face-gap));
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, color-mix(in oklab, var(--secondary) 80%, var(--card)), var(--card));
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  }
  .knob-pointer {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    rotate: calc(var(--knob-p, 0) * 270deg - 135deg);
    &::before {
      position: absolute;
      top: 10%;
      left: calc(50% - 1px);
      inline-size: 2px;
      block-size: 32%;
      border-radius: 1px;
      background-color: var(--foreground);
      content: "";
    }
  }
  /* the marks of the steps (data-ticks), between the value ring and the face */
  .knob-tick {
    position: absolute;
    inset: calc(var(--knob-slots) * var(--knob-step));
    pointer-events: none;
    rotate: calc(var(--knob-t, 0) * 270deg - 135deg);
    &::before {
      position: absolute;
      top: calc(var(--knob-thickness) + 1px);
      left: calc(50% - 0.5px);
      inline-size: 1px;
      block-size: calc(var(--knob-face-gap) - 2px);
      background-color: var(--muted-foreground);
      content: "";
    }
  }
  /* flat: no face - the rings and the pointer only */
  .knob[data-variant="flat"] .knob-face {
    border-color: transparent;
    background: none;
    box-shadow: none;
  }
  .knob-rings-text {
    position: absolute;
    inline-size: 1px;
    block-size: 1px;
    overflow: hidden;
    clip-path: inset(50%);
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .knob-dial::before,
    .knob-dial::after {
      transition: none;
    }
  }
  @media (prefers-contrast: more) {
    .knob {
      --knob-track-color: var(--muted-foreground);
    }
    .knob-face {
      border-color: var(--foreground);
    }
  }
  @media (forced-colors: active) {
    .knob-dial {
      --knob-color: Highlight;
      --knob-track-color: GrayText;
      forced-color-adjust: none;
    }
    .knob-face {
      border-color: CanvasText;
      background: Canvas;
    }
    .knob-pointer::before {
      background: CanvasText;
    }
    .knob-tick::before {
      background: GrayText;
    }
  }
}

§JavaScript view file

The scales and formats (and the registries a page adds to), the value settled on the range and step, the rings, the drag whose speed is the radius over the distance, the keys, the events and the State API.

// -- Knob ------------------------------------------------------
// A rotary control over a native <input type="range"> - the knobs of an audio plugin: the value on any scale (linear,
// exponential, logarithmic, power, decibel, or one the page registers), drawn as an arc from its origin and a pointer,
// rings around it for the automation and modulation sources that move it (their range and their live value), and a
// drag whose precision follows the distance from the knob: within its radius a horizontal move turns it fast, farther
// away slower and finer. The input stays the form control, the keyboard target and the accessible slider; the runtime
// draws the dial over it.
// Shared preamble (AGENTS.md "State API"); the implementation lives in core.js —
// build.ts rewrites this import into a df$.shadcn.shared binding in dist/.
import { defussGlobals, defussQuery, componentState, bindComponent, textLocale } from '../../../shared/state-api.js';

const knobStates = ['default', 'adjusting', 'disabled'];
/** The config every state takes. */
export interface KnobConfig {

// VERIFIED: (verify's API docs gate) the states below are exactly the declared ones, each
// described, and every config field typed, described and named in the code.
/** setState() configs per state. */
export interface KnobStateConfigs {
  /** At rest: the pointer and the arc from the origin show the value, the readout writes it. */
  default: KnobConfig;
  /** Being turned: the precision radius and the pointer's reach show around the dial - a drag enters it and returns to default when it ends. */
  adjusting: KnobConfig;

/** A ring around the knob: an automation or modulation source that moves its value. */
export interface KnobRing {

  id: string;
  /** the source's name ("LFO 1") - the ring's title and its description for assistive technology */
  label?: string;
  /** how far the source moves the knob, as a share of its turn: -1 to 1 (0.25 = a quarter of the turn up) */
  amount: number;
  /** a theme colour (chart-1 ... chart-5, primary, destructive) or a CSS colour; default the chart colour of its number */
  color?: string;

  bipolar?: boolean;

/** What a scale maps between. */
export interface KnobRange {
  /** the value at the start of the turn - the input's min */
  min: number;

  max: number;
  /** the curve of the power and decibel scales (data-exponent) */
  exponent: number;
}
/** A scale: how a position on the knob's turn (0 to 1) maps to a value, and back. */
export interface KnobScale {
  /** the value at a position of the turn */

/** What a format gets besides the value. */
export interface KnobFormatContext {

  unit: string;

  decimals: number | null;

  locale: string;

  /** the value at the end of the turn */

  /** the input's step, null for any */

export interface KnobChangeDetail {

  /** its position on the turn, 0 to 1 */

  text: string;
  /** true when the change is done (a drag ended, a key, a reset, setState), false while a drag goes on */
  committed: boolean;

/** a drag: the pointer, where it was, the position it moves (unrounded), the value it started from */
type Drag = { id: number; x: number; p: number; start: number; cx: number; cy: number; radius: number };
/** per-element runtime (state lives on the element) */
type Runtime = {
  input: HTMLInputElement;
  dial: HTMLElement;
  value: number;
  p: number;

/** the slowest a far drag gets, as a share of the full speed */
const MIN_SPEED = 0.02;
/** the keys' steps on the turn: an arrow, with Shift, a page */
const KEY_STEP = 0.01;
const FINE_STEP = 0.001;
const PAGE_STEP = 0.1;

};

/** the scales by name - a page adds its own with df$.shadcn.knob.scale() */
const SCALES: Record<string, KnobScale> = {
  linear,
  // equal ratios per share of the turn - frequency, time: from 20 Hz to 20 kHz every decade turns as far
  exponential: {
    value: (p, r) => (sameSign(r) ? r.min * Math.pow(r.max / r.min, p) : linear.value(p, r)),
    position: (v, r) => (sameSign(r) ? Math.log(v / r.min) / Math.log(r.max / r.min) : linear.position(v, r)),
  },
  // the mirror of exponential: fast at the start of the turn, fine at its end
  logarithmic: {
    value: (p, r) => (sameSign(r) ? r.min + r.max - r.min * Math.pow(r.max / r.min, 1 - p) : linear.value(p, r)),
    position: (v, r) =>
      sameSign(r) ? 1 - Math.log((r.min + r.max - v) / r.min) / Math.log(r.max / r.min) : linear.position(v, r),
  },
  // a curve: exponent 2 (default) is fine at the start, 0.5 fine at the end
  power: {
    value: (p, r) => r.min + (r.max - r.min) * Math.pow(p, r.exponent),
    position: (v, r) => Math.pow(clamp(linear.position(v, r), 0, 1), 1 / r.exponent),
  },
  // a gain in dB on an audio taper - the amplitude grows with the turn to the power of the exponent (3, default): the
  // turn's start is the min (-60 dB), its end the max
  decibel: {
    value: (p, r) => {
      const floor = Math.pow(10, (r.min - r.max) / (20 * r.exponent));
      return r.max + 20 * r.exponent * Math.log10(floor + (1 - floor) * p);
    },
    position: (v, r) => {
      const floor = Math.pow(10, (r.min - r.max) / (20 * r.exponent));

const fixed = (locale: string, digits: number) =>
  new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { minimumFractionDigits: digits, maximumFractionDigits: digits });
const three = (locale: string) =>

/** the fraction digits a value needs when the knob does not say: its step's, else fewer the wider its range */

const withUnit = (text: string, unit: string): string => (unit ? `${text} ${unit}` : text);
const SI: [number, string][] = [
  [1e9, 'G'],
  [1e6, 'M'],
  [1e3, 'k'],
  [1, ''],
  [1e-3, 'm'],

/** the formats by name - a page adds its own with df$.shadcn.knob.format() */
const FORMATS: Record<string, (value: number, context: KnobFormatContext) => string> = {

/** Show a value: settled on the knob's range and step, written into the input, painted - and told: the input's input

function speedAt(d: Drag, e: PointerEvent): number {

function init() {

    .toArray()
    .forEach((el: HTMLElement) => {
      el.dataset.init = '';

      // a range without a step snaps to whole numbers - the knob's values are as fine as its scale unless it says
      // (the browser has snapped the authored value already: it is read again under step="any")

        dfDollar(input).attr('step', 'any');
        if (input.hasAttribute('value')) input.value = input.defaultValue;
      }
      let data: unknown = null;
      try {
        data = JSON.parse(dfDollar(el).children('script.knob-rings').text() || 'null');
      } catch {
        data = null;
      }
      const id = `knob-rings-${++rings}`;
      const dial = dfDollar(`<span class="knob-dial" aria-hidden="true" data-describes="${id}"></span>`).get(
        0,
      ) as HTMLElement;

        dial,
        value: NaN,
        p: 0,
        committed: NaN,
        rings: ringsOf(data),
        live: new Map(),
        drag: null,
        writing: false,
        editor: null,

      el._knob = rt;
      renderDial(el);

          'data-exponent',
          'data-origin',

          'data-format',
          'data-decimals',
